supersedes_for_interpretation: config/vtnic_vertical_links_registry_v1.json -- v1 was run and is kept; its result stands as recorded
why_v2_exists: v1 (Step 357) selected each firm's 10 highest raw-vertscore partners. Its positive control nearly failed: same-month co-movement +0.043 (customers) and +0.032 (suppliers) against +0.337 for TNIC product peers. A spot check showed why: raw vertscore is dominated by hub firms whose 10-Ks name many products, so the 'top customers' of NVDA, ETN, MSFT and DE are the same set -- BRK-A, GGG, GTES, KALU, PH, ITT, EMR. v1 therefore did not test supply chains. This was found by inspecting the links, not by looking at any forward return beyond v1's own registered output.

candidates_declared_now.C1_lift: partner score = vertscore_ij / (mean outgoing vertscore of i x mean incoming vertscore of j), within the year; top 10 by lift
candidates_declared_now.C2_hub_exclusion: drop partners in the top 1% of firms by number of VTNIC links that year; top 10 by raw vertscore
candidates_declared_now.C3_lift_cross_sic2: C1, keeping only partners in a different SIC2 from the firm (vertical partners are usually in another industry)

construction_choice_rule.selection_statistic: mean over T1 and T2 of the DESIGN-WINDOW (2012-2018) same-month rank correlation between a firm's 21-day return and its partners' 21-day return. This measures link quality, not predictability; no forward return enters it.
construction_choice_rule.selection_then: the predictive screen is run ONCE, on the selected construction only. The other two are reported on the positive control only.
construction_choice_rule.minimum_link_quality: if no construction reaches same-month co-movement of +0.10, A21 is closed as 'no usable free vertical network' without a predictive run

trials: v1's T1 (customers lead suppliers) and T2 (suppliers lead customers), 1-month horizon, A19's controls, declared POSITIVE
measurement_and_pass_rule: A19's, word for word; design 2012-2018, holdout 2019-2023H1
cumulative_search_note: Counted as two new trials on top of v1's two. The construction selection uses no return-prediction information.
consequence_for_A20: A20's T2 ('A21's T1 partner set') uses the v2 selected construction. A20 had not been run when this was written.
